Bash(git -c commit.gpgsign=false commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Add position-aware borderless statement parser for Barclays PDFs

Existing strategies fail on borderless bank statements \(no grid lines,
text-based layout\). Add a new strategy that uses pdfplumber word-level
x-coordinates to detect column boundaries from header lines and assign
amounts to the correct columns \(Money out/Money in/Balance\) by position.

Handles same-date transaction groups, multi-line entries, and multi-page
statements. Also adds DD Mon date format support and a debug.py helper.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git -c commit.gpgsign=false commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Add statement summary with date range, total credited/debited

Return start date, end date, total credited, and total debited from
/api/convert. Extract year from PDF text for yearless date formats.
Display summary as cards above the results table on the frontend.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
